CI_consumption: Fetch this explicit public release asset without any live DB access.
Verify downloaded ZIP against committed asset.sha256; a remote checksum sidecar is informational only.
Verify required root member hashes and SHA256SUMS payload inventory; extract identical full.sql and all331Housing JSON files for the server release bundle.
Carry README.md, COMPLETED-RECIPE-UPDATES.json, TABLE-INVENTORY.json and checksums with the bundle; preserve fresh-empty-only semantics and reconstruction/source limitations.
database.future_update_policy: A newer matching database requires a separately assembled and validated sanitized DB release, its exact source commit/tag/asset hash, and an explicit committed update of this contract. Never silently select Latest/latest, redump a running DB, replay unfinished migrations, or enable drafts in CI.
database.metadata_basis: Existing verified November7 export receipt/README/SHA256SUMS only; no new DBquery/reassembly/test/runtime observation.
database.pin_semantics: Tag and asset name locate the release. The committed source commit and SHA256 identify the accepted immutable input; never trust a mutable Latest/latest database asset or its remote sidecar as replacement authority.

required_code_boundary.compatible_descendants_must_preserve: Completed RRC310 property-preserving recharge and RRC312-r2 full32 actor contracts plus matching integrated housing/reward/schema/quest/opcode contracts. Build pins exact server revision separately.
required_code_boundary.external_operator_resources: Authenticated original RoF2 archives/maps and matching server quests/opcodes; generate fresh target shared memory normally.

future_updates: Change these explicit committed source/asset/hash pins only after owner-reviewed sanitized releases/portable content are ready; never discover mutable Latest as an input.

runtime_content.excluded: Never reuse seed binaries/DLLs/launch scripts/RELEASE metadata/SQL. Native binaries/helpers always come from this workflow commit; DB always from separately pinned sanitized asset.
